title: How I know we can share dreams
content: My brother and I are proof. For years I dreamt of being a condo we and our newly divorced mother lived in, but I was always alone in the dreams and there was always someone trying to get in. I refer to them as the Southwood dreams. Fast forward a good 10 years later and my big bro are chillin on the sofa and start talking about our messed up dreams and I’m like “yeah, I always have dreams about Southwood and someone’s always trying to get in.” He pauses for a good 5 seconds and says with weirded out smirk, “that’s funny, because whenever I have Southwood dreams I’m always trying to get in because I’m locked out.” We laughed, blown away, and we both stopped having the dream. I still dream about Southwood but I’m never alone anymore and no one is ever trying to break in.
